title: The MVTec AD 2 Dataset: Advanced Scenarios for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
mechanism: Benchmark design: hidden test ground truth on an evaluation server, test splits with lighting / distribution shift, very small defects; shows SOTA below 60% AU-PRO.
adaptation: Template for the EL benchmark: hidden unseen-module test (E1-style), half-cut / new-module shift split, thresholded per-image segmentation F1 alongside AU-PRO, separate AD track.
min_experiment: No training; adopt split and metric design in the benchmark protocol.
evidence: R: 8 scenarios, >8000 high-resolution images; SOTA methods below 60% average AU-PRO.
